description: Generic-b order-eight matched-surface check of NSRR theta sewing by double Virasoro against its partial-S transformed NSNSNS theta sewing by direct N=1 c-recursion

marked_surface.transformation: partial S on the second handle, followed by the integer period-basis change used by the target theta chart

source_nsrr.majorana_spin_change: multiply the physical NS reference determinant selected by the lifts by |theta[01|10]/theta[00|10]|

convention_ledger.all_NS_three_point: C_HN^(0)=C_BRY and C_HN^(1)=i*tilde_C_BRY, with the phase inserted exactly once before squaring
convention_ledger.NSRR_three_point: HJS eta=+ maps to C_even and eta=- maps to C_odd, with one overall 1/2 completeness factor
convention_ledger.NSRR_closed_R_edges: sum both diagonal Type-0B Ramond ground labels on each of the two internal R edges, giving factor four
convention_ledger.NSRR_branching_coefficients: use the finite-cutoff Ward recursion relation for the branching coefficients, with only certified low-state anchors
convention_ledger.NSRR_double_virasoro: compute the product of the two ordinary genus-two Virasoro blocks by applying c-recursion to each factor; do not use a direct PBW genus-two block contraction
convention_ledger.generic_b_leg_normalization: Poghossian reflection-symmetric NS/R metrics and the common b^(-3) per pants are included
convention_ledger.cosmological_factor: when omitted, either genus-two partition is restored by K_b^(-Q/b)
convention_ledger.free_denominator: one noncompact scalar plus one physical Majorana evaluated in the same local theta plumbing frame as its numerator
convention_ledger.weyl_anomaly: raise the free superfield answer to kappa=c_SL/(3/2)=1+2(b+1/b)^2

provenance.template: most recent Human-Note all-NS Cannon cross-channel certification workflow
provenance.sharding: one immutable Cartesian momentum node per channel task; deterministic node-ordered reduction
provenance.precision_axis: fixed total block order eight with quadrature orders 8, 10, and 12
